name: North Carolina

rule.hpNote: motor of 10 hp or greater (PWC included)
rule.textEn: Anyone born on or after Jan. 1, 1988 must pass a NASBLA-approved boating course before running any boat with a motor of 10 hp or more, PWC included.
rule.textEs: Quien nació el 1 de enero de 1988 o después debe aprobar un curso náutico aprobado por NASBLA antes de manejar cualquier embarcación con motor de 10 hp o más, incluidas las motos acuáticas.

minAge.note: PWC: alone from 16; ages 14-15 only with an adult 18+ on board who meets the education law, or carrying proof of age and a boating safety card.

card.feeNote: The commission keeps records only for its own courses; online providers issue their own proof of completion.

rental: PWCs may not be rented to anyone under 16 unless they meet the 14-15 conditions; rented PWCs must carry at least $300,000 insurance.
pwcExtra: Ages 14-15 may ride only with an adult 18+ aboard who complies with the education law, or while carrying ID and a boating safety card. No PWC between sunset and sunrise.

sources.quote: Any person born on or after January 1, 1988 must successfully complete a NASBLA approved boating education course before operating any vessel propelled by a motor of 10 HP or greater. G.S. 75A-16.2
